evidence.why: Category-1 visual completion, reset calls, availability scan and fallback.
Fallback and selection predicates access stage_mask.

facts.rationale: Corrects the rendered HiddenCharacters name. The canonical reset callee clears the stage-unlock mask, and the subsequent scan and fallback operate on stage availability and stage-selection bits. The descriptive name is supported; exact original spelling remains unrecovered.

evidence.why: Availability predicate distinguishes unlocked and ordinary stages.

facts.rationale: Canonical stage-mask accessors and the unlock predicate establish the domain independently of rendered names or a generic wiki description of another deletion category.
facts.value: Implements the stage-unlock deletion category at Erase Data entry 1, rather than Hidden Characters. It clears unlocked-stage state and performs the associated reset call, then ensures that at least one available stage remains enabled in the stage-selection mask, enabling index 0 if the 29-entry scan finds none.

evidence.why: Entry-5 escalation, rejection and cooldown overwrite.
Direct category actions and terminal/toggle branches.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exceptional cooldown overwrite and second-stage transition omitted by the baseline's uniform five-tick description.
facts.value: Confirm initially sets cooldown to 5. For entry 5, an affirmative response sets warning state 2, resets the response to 0, replaces the warning text with SIS 319, installs fn_8024F1D4, overwrites cooldown with 10, plays sound 0xBD and returns; rejection clears warning state and restores main input. For entries 0..4, affirmation executes and marks the selected reset and plays sound 0xBE, while rejection only backs out; both clear warning visibility and restore fn_8024F840. Back cancels with cooldown 5. Horizontal input toggles the response without closing the prompt. Confirm has priority over Back and movement.

evidence.why: Global state lookup and successor registration on the argument.
Input GObj is created separately after screen construction.

facts.rationale: Corrects conflation of input-process ownership with display/user-data ownership.
facts.value: GObj process callback with signature void (HSD_GObj*). Its argument is the separately created input-controller GObj and receives successor confirmation processes. Shared MnDataDelGObjUserData is obtained from mnDataDel_804D6C68, the display GObj, not from the callback argument.

evidence.why: Masks 1 and 2 are Up and Down; Left and Right are 4 and 8.

facts.rationale: Corrects Left/Right to Up/Down using canonical input-mask definitions; the remainder of the supported purpose is preserved.
facts.value: Serves as the Erase Data menu's active input callback: after its cooldown guard, it handles leaving the menu, opening confirmation for an eligible selected category, and moving the six-entry cursor Up or Down with wraparound while updating highlights and descriptive text.

evidence.why: Display-only entrance, selection and exit transitions.
Warning input transitions and category reset dispatch.
Main input's eligibility gate and warning creation.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's serialized opening-to-input lifecycle and preserves separate display, input and warning ownership, including the interrupted-entrance path.
facts.value: Entry establishes menu state 0x18 and cooldown 5, constructs a display GObj with an opening-animation process, and independently schedules ordinary input on another GObj immediately. Entrance completion switches the display process to selection highlighting, not to input. Eligible confirmation replaces the input process with the first-warning handler and creates a separate warning GObj. Affirmative entries 0..4 execute their individual reset and mark completion; affirmative entry 5 sets warning state 2, resets the response, sets cooldown 10 and installs the final-warning input handler. Final affirmative confirmation performs the all-data action; cancellation or completion hides the warning and restores main input. A current-menu change redirects the entrance or selection-display callback to exit animation and releases its description; the exit callback removes the display GObj at its animation endpoint. Cleanup of the independent input GObj is not shown here.
